thread:
Alex: planning to push engine v2.3.1 + quant profile qp-11 to canary slice tomorrow 08:00 PT. target slots: r3-gpu-24a/b. rolling update, no customer-facing downtime expected. asking for smoke owners and rollback owner.

Maria: ack — I can run perf vectors and kv-cache warmup checks. will post results ~08:15 PT.

Tim: can we add tracing hooks and a short sampling rule? I'll watch traces and PagerDuty. also need a rollback snapshot ID prepared.

deploy-bot: Deploy window reserved: 2026-03-18 08:00-09:00 PT. Claimed slots: r3-gpu-24a,b.

Sasha: quick Q — qp-11 had a compatibility note for some layernorm kernels in the diff. is 7b covered?

Alex: good catch. validated on gpt-like up to 13b but not exhaustive on 7b. Sasha, can you run a tiny L0/compat run on 7b? fallback plan is qp-10 if we see errors.

Sasha: running L0 now, hitting the QA harness. pinging @Tim for rollback ownership if needed.

Tim: I will own rollback. prepping one-click playbook and the rollback snapshot. health checks for abort: error rate > 1% in 5m OR p95 latency regress > 50ms. I'll paste the playbook link before deploy.

Alex: added warmup flag to deploy config to avoid cold-kv spikes. also PR #5482 (kernel selector tweak) needs one more review — @Raj can you take a look? small change but affects canary path.

Raj: taking a look now. will merge if green, before the window.

Maria: perf vectors queued. note: please enable cache warmup and set sample rate to 10% during canary to keep load realistic.

Sasha: L0 passed on 7b, no errors. moving to a small canary run.

Alex: thanks — I'll schedule the canary and post a short checklist in this thread when starting. :thumbsup:

Maria: adding smoke alert to PagerDuty for the slice "canary-r3-gpu-24" (if error rate spikes).

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started 2026-03-18T08:00:12Z (slice: canary-r3-gpu-24)

Alex: monitoring now. ping here if you see anything weird. if we need to rollback, tag me and @Tim and use the one-click playbook.

Tim: rollback plan uploaded: /runbooks/engine-rollback-2026-03 (link). I'll be on standby for rollback execution.

Raj: merged PR #5482. infra tests green.

Maria: perf results (first 5m): p50 45ms, p95 160ms, errors 0.07%. KV warmup looks good.

Sasha: small regression in top-k selection on one test vector — investigating, could be quant edge-case. will update in 5.

Alex: keep investigating. if it doesn’t clear in 10m we revert to qp-10 on canary.

Sasha: found a bad path in a fallback kernel, pushing a quick fix PR. if it blocks merging, we'll revert qp on canary.

Alex: ack. thanks for the quick turnaround. posting final status after the window.

Maria: smoke complete, canary stable for 30m. recommending rollout to next slice per plan.

Alex: rolling to next slice now. thanks everyone.
